chunks: Aban narrated from Bukayr and al-Halabi, from one of the two Imams, peace be upon them, who said:
The maternal siblings have one-third along with the grandfather, and he is a sharer with the paternal siblings.

key_terms.الْإِخْوَةِ مِنَ الْأُمِّ: maternal siblings who inherit through the mother's side
key_terms.الْجَدِّ: the grandfather as an inheriting relative
key_terms.شَرِيكُ الْإِخْوَةِ مِنَ الْأَبِ: sharing jointly with the paternal siblings in inheritance

ai.seo_question: How is inheritance divided between maternal siblings, the grandfather, and paternal siblings in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on inheritance shares involving maternal siblings, the grandfather, and paternal siblings. It states that the maternal siblings receive one-third, while the grandfather shares together with the paternal siblings in the remaining inheritance.
